items.text: Attacking farm animals now flags you as hostile to the safezone, blocking safezone entry after aggression.
Critter behavior overhauled: populations adjusted, squirrels stay out of riverside/ocean areas, and hitbox collisions fixed for smoother interaction and combat.
Animal interactions around vehicles restored and Generation 2 AI creatures can now be mounted via the new NPCMountable component (currently teleports to mount).
Fence gates open and close twice as slowly for smoother operation; fence colliders are fixed, fences can be demolished with a hammer and are highlighted in blue like upgradable items.
Key binding assignments no longer break when closing the menu mid‑assign, fixing gamepad issues.
Input latching cleared correctly, preventing unintended actions such as the F1 console opening automatically, and the map UI now includes a functional close button.
Salvaged cleaver reach corrected to match its intended distance.
Raw beef can now be cooked into cooked beef again, and ovens now support additional meat types for expanded cooking options.

2026-09-14.summary:
### Animals & AI
- Attacking farm animals now flags you as hostile to the safezone, blocking safezone entry after aggression.
- Critter behavior overhauled: populations adjusted, squirrels stay out of riverside/ocean areas, and hitbox collisions fixed for smoother interaction and combat.
- Animal interactions around vehicles restored and Generation 2 AI creatures can now be mounted via the new NPCMountable component (currently teleports to mount).

### Structures & Tools
- Fence gates open and close twice as slowly for smoother operation; fence colliders are fixed, fences can be demolished with a hammer and are highlighted in blue like upgradable items.

### Input & UI
- Key binding assignments no longer break when closing the menu mid‑assign, fixing gamepad issues.
- Input latching cleared correctly, preventing unintended actions such as the F1 console opening automatically, and the map UI now includes a functional close button.

### Combat & Tools
- Salvaged cleaver reach corrected to match its intended distance.

### Cooking & Food
- Raw beef can now be cooked into cooked beef again, and ovens now support additional meat types for expanded cooking options.

2026-09-13.summary:
### Animals & Resources
- Cows now drop beef instead of generic cow meat.

### Weapons
- Mini crossbow functionality restored after fix.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Sheep now correctly produce poop, restoring the fertilizer resource.

### Bug Fixes
- Resolved a manifest error caused by null bones in cow skeleton assets; the game now logs a warning instead of crashing.
